summary: Scinai Immunotherapeutics filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 16, 2026, announcing the closing of a roughly $4.0 million private placement of 2,458,334 American Depositary Shares (or pre-funded warrants) plus Series A-1 Warrants for up to 3,687,501 ADSs, alongside a warrant inducement involving exercise of 879,194 existing warrants at a reduced $1.20 per ADS. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners was sole placement agent. This is a routine equity financing, not a special situation; proceeds fund CDMO programs and pipeline, with runway guided to late 2027.
